connectorUiConfig.title: QCrypton PQC Scanner (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [QCrypton PQC Scanner](https://www.qcrypton.com/) data connector provides the capability to ingest post-quantum cryptography readiness findings from your Azure environment into Microsoft Sentinel through the QCrypton API. Findings include Key Vault key posture (RSA/ECC vs. PQ-hybrid), TLS certificate signature algorithms on public endpoints, Storage Account and App Service TLS configuration, and CMK provenance.

sampleQueries.description: All quantum-vulnerable findings in the last 24h
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| project TimeGenerated, ResourceName, AssetKind, Algorithm, PostureReason, RiskScore
| order by RiskScore desc

sampleQueries.description: Vulnerable Key Vault keys grouped by subscription
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where AssetKind == 'kv-key' and QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| summarize count() by SubscriptionId, Algorithm

sampleQueries.description: TLS certs expiring after 2030 still using classical signatures
sampleQueries.query:
PQReadiness_CL
| where AssetKind in ('tls-cert', 'kv-cert') and QuantumPosture == 'vulnerable'
| where ExpiresOn > datetime(2030-01-01)
| project ResourceName, AssetIdentifier, SignatureAlgorithm, ExpiresOn, RiskScore

dataTypes.name: PQReadiness_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
PQReadiness_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

instructionSteps.title: Connect QCrypton PQC Scanner to Microsoft Sentinel

parameters.content: This connector polls the QCrypton PQC Scanner API to retrieve post-quantum cryptography readiness findings and ingest them into the **PQReadiness_CL** table in your Log Analytics workspace.

#### 1. API Key
Obtain your QCrypton API key from the [QCrypton Portal](https://portal.qcrypton.com). Navigate to **Settings > API Keys** and generate a key with read access to scan findings.

#### 2. API Server URL
Enter the base URL of your QCrypton API server. The default is `https://api.qcrypton.com`. If you use a dedicated or regional instance, enter the URL provided by QCrypton.

parameters.label: QCrypton API Server URL
parameters.name: apiServerUrl
parameters.description: Enter the QCrypton API base URL. Do not include a trailing slash or path.
